history.title: Resource trend
history.empty: Select a process to begin recording its trend.
history.exited: The process exited; trend updates stopped.

errors.targetChanged: The process already exited or changed. Nothing else was stopped.
errors.permissionDenied: The operating system did not allow CoreRobin to control this process. CoreRobin will not request administrator access automatically.
errors.noCloseWindow: This background process has no app window that Windows can ask to close. Use Force quit only if you understand the risk.
errors.unavailable: This action is not available for the selected process on this system.
errors.busy: Too many process confirmations are open. Close one and try again.

dialog.windowsForce: This ends the process immediately. It may not have time to save its current work.
dialog.unixForce: This ends the process immediately. It may not have time to save its current work, and the action cannot be undone.
dialog.request: Ask the process to exit on its own so it has time to save and clean up.
dialog.stableIdentity: The action applies only to the process you just confirmed. It is cancelled if the target changes.
dialog.bestEffortIdentity: CoreRobin confirms the process identity again before acting. It will not continue if the target changed.
